name: Ikh Zasag International University
nameMn: Их засаг олон улсын их сургууль
descriptionMn: Их засаг олон улсын их сургууль нь 1994 онд байгуулагдаж, 2011 онд олон улсын их сургууль нэртэй болсон. Албан ёсны сайтад жилд ойролцоогоор 7,000 оюутан суралцдаг, Улаанбаатарт хоёр кампустай, нийт 14 сургуультай гэж бичсэн. Бакалаврын хөтөлбөрүүд 10 сургуульд 40 гаруй мэргэжлээр явагддаг бөгөөд хууль, нягтлан бодох бүртгэл, аялал жуулчлалын магистр, хуулийн докторын хөтөлбөртэй.
faculties: School of Medicine and Health Sciences
Chingis Khaan School of International Relations
School of Security and Law Enforcement

dorm.note: Two student dormitories exist (Ikh Zasag Chingis complex and Chingis SOOSE complex); cost not published on the page. Foreign students pay dormitory fees themselves.

admission.otherEnglishNote: Foreign bachelor applicants must demonstrate English proficiency; a placement test is given on enrollment. No minimum score stated.
requirements: Foreign bachelor applicants: high school education recognized in Mongolia (verified via Education Evaluation Center)
Application form, national ID copy, passport copy
Previous diploma copies with Mongolian certified translation
English diploma reference with QR code
admission.applicationFee: Mongolian applicants: 5,000 MNT registration fee; foreign applicant fee not stated

scholarships.name: Super Student scholarship
scholarships.coverage: Study at foreign universities with 100% tuition coverage

scholarships.name: Rector's Scholarship / Chinggis Khaan Scholarship
scholarships.coverage: For five / six consecutive quarters of A grades
